description: Animates a still image into a short video clip (Seedance 1.0 Lite).

prompt.description: The text prompt used to generate the video.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the output video.

duration.description: The duration of the output video in seconds.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

camera_fixed.description: Specifies whether to fix the camera. The platform appends an instruction to fix the camera to your prompt, but does not guarantee the actual effect.

generate_audio.description: This parameter is ignored for any model except seedance-1-5-pro.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output video.

watermark.description: Whether to add an "AI generated" watermark to the video.
